character.name: GrangerPet Hermione
character.prompt: Full body Hermione Granger desktop pet. Smooth detailed 2D hand-drawn cel animation, NOT pixel art. Wavy chestnut hair, brown eyes, Hogwarts dark robe, grey sweater, burgundy gold tie, skirt, tights and shoes, book. Slight chibi 3.8 heads tall. Facing viewer in three-quarter pose, relaxed standing. Head hands feet fully visible, centered. Clean contours, expressive face. Plain background, no text.
